purpose: Automatically continue an unfinished scheduled editorial run when the model attempts to stop.
implementation: Codex UserPromptSubmit, Stop and Interrupt lifecycle command hooks; controller executes published gate independently of the model.
nativeTestScope: Real installed Codex CLI and trusted lifecycle hooks, local simulated Responses model and simulated completion results; not an additional live twenty-page editorial run.

hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: Automatic continuation controller armed for 2026-11-26. Use that saved assignment date throughout this run.

actualPublishedDayControllerCheck.systemMessage: Editorial controller: verification and remote push confirmed; run complete.

behavior: Activation occurs before model work through the automation marker, not an optional agent command.
Every incomplete Stop returns block and automatically produces another continuation, including repeated stop_hook_active events.
Assignment date and progress survive midnight and controller process restarts.
User interruption suspends continuation; paused automation disables it.
A subsequent scheduled run recovers the oldest unfinished bound assignment.
limits: Requires Codex running with the trusted project hooks enabled.
Cannot override application shutdown, unavailable model service or usage limits.
No independent operating-system restart service was installed.
